title: The OpenAI board member who fired Sam Altman says we still can’t trust AI CEOs
summary: Today, I’m talking with Helen Toner, the executive director of the Center for Security and Emerging Technology at Georgetown University. This episode is part two of our series on AI in real life. Helen is a well-known figure in the AI safety and policy community, though she is perhaps best known for having served on […]
llm_summary: In this episode, Helen Toner—who sits on OpenAI’s board and leads Georgetown’s Center for Security and Emerging Technology— explains why, even after Sam Altman’s ouster, she still doubts that AI CEOs can be fully trusted to self‑regulate. She argues that the rapid pace of AI development, combined with opaque corporate governance and the high stakes of powerful models, makes external oversight and robust policy frameworks essential.
